# Slim Geregeld Administratie

> Dutch bookkeeping practice of Kyle Bouwmeester, a Becon-registered bookkeeper (Becon 781794, KVK 92596991) in the Netherlands. In English, Slim Geregeld prepares and signs the opening balance sheet and the renewal statement for self-employed residence permits under the Dutch American Friendship Treaty (DAFT) and the 1913 Dutch-Japanese Trade Treaty. In Dutch, it does bookkeeping, VAT returns and income tax returns for freelancers and small businesses.

Key facts for the treaty route:

- The IND asks for EUR 4,500 of owner's equity on a balance sheet signed by an authorised independent external expert. A Becon-registered bookkeeper is on the IND's list of accepted experts.
- First application: opening balance sheet, EUR 495 excluding VAT within five working days, or EUR 595 within 48 hours. Fully remote and in English.
- Renewal: a balance sheet and profit and loss account for the current and previous financial year; a bank statement alone is not enough. The first permit runs two years, the renewal grants five. The statement is EUR 495 excluding VAT within five working days, or EUR 595 within 48 hours, if the figures exist; writing up missing years is quoted in advance.
- Compliance Plan: monthly bookkeeping for an eenmanszaak or VOF with a treaty permit, EUR 79 or EUR 149 a month excluding VAT, minimum 12 months, including the balance sheet, the quarterly equity check and the renewal statement.
- Slim Geregeld does not file US tax returns and does not give legal or immigration advice.

## Treaty permits (English)

- [DAFT opening balance sheet](https://slim-geregeld.nl/daft/): for US citizens (IND purpose 453); who can apply, what the IND wants, pricing, FAQ and the request form
- [DJTT opening balance sheet](https://slim-geregeld.nl/djtt/): for Japanese nationals under the Dutch-Japanese Trade Treaty (IND purpose 510), same requirements and prices, with its own request form
- [DJTT opening balance sheet, Japanese](https://slim-geregeld.nl/djtt/ja/): the same page in Japanese; the form and all communication are in English
- [Permit renewal statement](https://slim-geregeld.nl/daft/renewal/): what the IND asks for at renewal under either treaty, pricing and the request form
- [Ask a question](https://slim-geregeld.nl/daft/contact/): contact form, personal reply within one working day
